1.1: Kol kinnuye nezirut kinzirut. haomer ehe, hare ze nazir. o ehe nave, nazir. nazik, naziach, paziach, hare ze nazir. hareni kaze, hareni mesalsel, hareni mechalkel, hare alay leshallach pera, hare ze nazir. hare alay tzipporim, rabbi meir omer, nazir. vachachamim omrim, eno nazir:
1.2: Hareni nazir min hachartzannim, umin hazzaggim, umin hattiglachat, umin hattuma, hare ze nazir vechol dikduke nezirut alav. hareni cheshimshon, keven manoach, kevaal delila, kemi sheakar daltot azza, kemi shennikkeru felishtim et enav, hare ze nezir shimshon. ma ben nezir olam linzir shimshon. nezir olam, hichbid searo, mekel betaar umevi shalosh behemot. veim nitma, mevi karban tuma. nezir shimshon, hichbid searo, eno mekel. veim nitma, eno mevi karban tuma:
1.3: Setam nezirut sheloshim yom. amar hareni nazir achat gedola, hareni nazir achat ketanna, afillu mikkan vead sof haolam, nazir sheloshim yom. hareni nazir veyom echad, hareni nazir veshaa echat, hareni nazir achat umechetza, hare ze nazir shetayim. hareni nazir sheloshim yom veshaa echat, nazir sheloshim veechad yom, sheen nozrim leshaot:
1.4: Hareni nazir kisar roshi, vechaafar haaretz, uchechol hayyam, hare ze nezir olam umegalleach achat lishloshim yom. rabbi omer, en ze megalleach achat lishloshim yom. veezehu shemmegalleach achat lishloshim yom, haomer hare alay nezirut kisar roshi, vechaafar haaretz, uchechol hayyam:
1.5: Hareni nazir melo habbayit o melo hakkuppa, bodkin oto, im amar achat gedola nazarti, nazir sheloshim yom. veim amar setam nazarti, roin et hakkuppa keillu hi melea chardal, venazir kol yamav:
1.6: Hareni nazir mikkan ad makom peloni, omdin kamma yamim mikkan ad makom peloni, im pachot mishsheloshim yom, nazir sheloshim yom, veim lav, nazir keminyan hayyamim:
1.7: Hareni nazir keminyan yemot hachamma, mone nezirut keminyan yemot hachamma. amar rabbi yehuda, maase haya, kevan shehishlim met:

2.1: Hareni nazir min haggerogarot umin haddevela, bet shammay omrim, nazir, uvet hillel omrim, eno nazir. amar rabbi yehuda, af kesheamru vet shammay, lo amru ella veomer hare hen alay karban:
2.2: Amar, amra fara zo hareni nezira im omedet ani. amar, haddelet hazze hareni nazir im niftach ani. bet shammay omrim, nazir, uvet hillel omrim, eno nazir. amar rabbi yehuda, af kesheamru vet shammay, lo amru ella veomer hare fara zo alay karban im omedet hi:
2.3: Mazgu lo et hakkos, veamar hareni nazir mimmenu, hare ze nazir. maase veishsha achat shehayta shikkora umazgu lah et hakkos, veamra hareni nezira mimmennu, amru chachamim, lo nitkavvena ella lomar hare hu alay karban:
2.4: Hareni nazir al menat sheehe shote yayin umittamme lemetim, hare ze nazir veasur bechullan. yodea ani sheyyesh nezirut aval eni yodea shehannazir asur beyyayin, hare ze asur. verabbi shimon mattir. yodea ani shehannazir asur beyyayin aval savur hayiti shechachamim mattirim li mippene sheen ani yachol lichyot ella veyyayin, o mippene sheani kover et hammetim, hare ze muttar. verabbi shimon oser:
2.5: Hareni nazir vealay legalleach nazir, veshama chavero veamar vaani vealay legalleach nazir, im hayu fikkechim, megallechim ze et ze. veim lav, megallechim nezirim acherim:
2.6: Hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir, veshama chavero veamar vaani alay legalleach chatzi nazir, ze megalleach nazir shalem veze megalleach nazir shalem, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ze megalleach chatzi nazir veze megalleach chatzi nazir:
2.7: Hareni nazir lichsheyyihye li ven, venolad lo ven, hare ze nazir. nolad lo vat, tumtum, veanderoginos, eno nazir. im amar, kesheere, kesheyyihye li valad, afillu nolad lo vat, tumtum, veanderoginos, hare ze nazir:
2.8: Hippila ishto, eno nazir. rabbi shimon omer, yomar, im haya ven keyama, hare ani nezir chova. veim lav, hare ani nezir nedava. chazra veyalda, hare ze nazir. rabbi shimon omer, yomar, im harishon ben keyama, harishon chova vezo nedava. veim lav, harishon nedava vezo chova:
2.9: Hareni nazir, venazir kesheyyihye li ven, hitchil mone et shello veachar kach nolad lo ven, mashlim et shello veachar kach mone et shel beno. hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ven venazir, hitchil mone et shello veachar kach nolad lo ven, manniach et shello umone et shel beno, veachar kach mashlim et shello:
2.10: Hareni nazir lichsheyyehe li ven, venazir mea yom. nolad lo ven ad shivim, lo hifsid kelum. leachar shivim, soter shivim, sheen tiglachat pachot mishsheloshim yom:

3.1: Mi sheamar hareni nazir, megalleach yom sheloshim veechad. veim gillach leyom sheloshim, yatza. hareni nazir sheloshim yom, im gillach leyom sheloshim lo yatza:
3.2: Mi shennazar shete neziriyyot, megalleach et harishona yom sheloshim veechad, veet hashsheniyya yom shishshim veechad. veim gillach et harishona yom sheloshim, megalleach et hashsheniyya yom shishshim. veim gillach yom shishshim chaser echad, yatza. vezo edut heid rabbi pappeyas al mi shennazar shete neziriyyot, sheim gillach et harishona sheloshim yom, megalleach et hashsheniyya yom shishshim. veim gillach leyom shishshim chaser echad, yatza, sheyyom sheloshim ole lo min hamminyan:
3.3: Mi sheamar hareni nazir, nitma yom sheloshim, soter et hakkol. rabbi eliezer omer, eno soter ella shiva. hareni nazir sheloshim yom, nitma yom sheloshim, soter et hakkol:
3.4: Hareni nazir mea yom, nitma yom mea, soter et hakkol. rabbi eliezer omer, eno soter ella sheloshim. nitma yom mea veechad, soter sheloshim yom. rabbi eliezer omer, eno soter ella shiva:
3.5: Mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot, afillu haya sham sheloshim yom, en olin lo min hamminyan veeno mevi karban tuma. yatza venichnas, olin lo min hamminyan umevi karban tuma. rabbi eliezer omer, lo vo vayyom, shenneemar (Bamidbar 6) vehayyamim harishonim yippelu, ad sheyyihyu lo yamim rishonim:
3.6: Mi shennazar nezirut harebe vehishlim et neziruto, veachar kach ba laaretz, bet shammay omrim, nazir sheloshim yom, uvet hillel omrim, nazir battechilla. maase vehilni hammalka, shehalach benah lammilchama, veamra, im yavo veni min hammilchama veshalom ehe nezira sheva shanim, uva venah min hammilchama, vehayta nezira sheva shanim. uvesof sheva shanim alta laaretz, vehoruha vet hillel shettehe nezira od sheva shanim acherot. uvesof sheva shanim nitmet, venimtzet nezira esrim veachat shana. amar rabbi yehuda, lo hayta nezira ella arba esre shana:
3.7: Mi shehayu shete chitte edim meidot oto, ellu meidim shennazar shetayim, veellu meidim shennazar chamesh, bet shammay omrim, nechleka haedut veen kan nezirut. uvet hillel omrim, yesh bichlal chamesh shetayim, sheyyehe nazir shetayim:

4.1: Mi sheamar hareni nazir, veshama chavero veamar vaani, vaani, kullam nezirin. huttar harishon, hutteru chullan. huttar haacharon, haacharon muttar vechullam asurin. amar hareni nazir, veshama chavero veamar, pi chefiv useari chisaro, hare ze nazir. hareni nazir, veshama ishto veamra, vaani, mefer et shellah, veshello kayyam. hareni nezira, veshama balah veamar, vaani, eno yachol lehafer:
4.2: Hareni nazir, vaat, veamra amen, mefer et shellah, veshello kayyam. hareni nezira, vaatta, veamar amen, eno yachol lehafer:
4.3: Haishsha shennadra venazir, vehayta shota veyayin umittammea lemetim, hare zo sofeget et haarbaim. hefer lah balah vehi lo yada shehefer lah balah, vehayta shota veyayin umittammea lemetim, enah sofeget et haarbaim. rabbi yehuda omer, im enah sofeget et haarbaim, tispog makkat mardut:
4.4: Haishsha shennadra venazir vehifrisha et behemtah veachar kach hefer lah balah, im shello hayta vehemtah, tetze vetire vaeder. veim shellah hayta vehemtah, hachattat tamut, veola tikrav ola, vehashshelamim yikrevu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lachem. hayu lah maot setumim, yippelu lindava. maot meforashim, deme chattat, yelchu leyam hammelach, lo nehenim velo moalim bahen. deme ola, yaviu ola, umoalim bahen. deme shelamim, yaviu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lachem:
4.5: Nizrak aleha echad min haddamim, eno yachol lehafer. rabbi akiva omer, afillu nishchata aleha achat mikkol habbehemot, eno yachol lehafer. bamme devarim amurim, betiglachat hattohora. aval betiglachat hattuma, yafer, shehu yachol lomar i efshi veishsha menuvvalet. rabbi omer, af betiglachat hattohora yafer, shehu yachol lomar i efshi beishsha megullachat:
4.6: Haish maddir et beno venazir, veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir. ketzad, gillach o sheggillechuhu kerovav, micha o shemmichu kerovav, hayta lo vehema mufreshet, hachattat tamut veola tikrav ola vehashshelamim yikrevu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lachem. hayu lo maot setumin, yippelu lindava. maot meforashin, deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach, lo nehenin velo moalin. deme ola, yaviu ola umoalin bahen. deme shelamim, yaviu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lachem:
4.7: Haish megalleach al nezirut aviv veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha. ketzad. mi shehaya aviv nazir vehifrish maot setumim al neziruto umet, veamar hareni nazir al menat sheagallach al meot abba, amar rabbi yose, hare ellu yippelu lindava, en ze megalleach al nezirut aviv. ezehu shemmegalleach al nezirut aviv, mi shehaya hu veaviv nezirim vehifrish aviv maot setumim linziruto umet, zehu shemmegalleach al nezirut aviv:

5.1: Bet shammay omrim, hekdesh taut hekdesh. uvet hillel omrim, eno hekdesh. ketzad. amar, shor shachor sheyyetze mibbeti rishon hare hu hekdesh, veyatza lavan, bet shammay omrim hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh:
5.2: Dinar zahav sheyyaale veyadi rishon hare hu hekdesh, veala shel kesef, bet shammay omrim hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh. chavit shel yayin shettaale veyadi rishona hare hi hekdesh, vealta shel shemen, bet shammay omrim hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh:
5.3: Mi shennadar benazir venishal lechacham vaasaro, mone mishshaa shennadar. nishal lechacham vehittiro, hayta lo vehema mufreshet, tetze vetire vaeder. amru vet hillel levet shammay, i attem modim baze shehu hekdesh taut shettetze vetire vaeder. amru lahen bet shammay, i attem modim bemi shettaa vekara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri shehu mekuddash. amru lahem bet hillel, lo hashshevet kiddesho. uma illu taa vehinniach et hashshevet al shemini veal shenem asar, shemma asa chelum. ella katuv shekkiddesh et haasiri, hu kiddesh et hatteshii veet achad asar:
5.4: Mi shennadar benazir vehalach lehavi et behemto umetzaah shennigneva, im ad shello nigneva vehemto nazar, hare ze nazir. veim mishshennigneva vehemto nazar, eno nazir. vezo taut taa nachum hammadi keshealu nezirim min haggola umatzu vet hammikdash charev, amar lahem nachum hammadi, illu heyitem yodim shebbet hammikdash charev heyitem nozrim. amru lo lo, vehittiran nachum hammadi. ucheshebba haddavar etzel chachamim, amru lo, kol shennazar ad shello charav bet hammikdash, nazir. umishshecharav bet hammikdash, eno nazir:
5.5: Hayu mehallechin badderech veechad ba chenegdan, amar echad mehen hareni nazir shezze feloni, veechad amar hareni nazir sheen ze feloni, hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir, sheen echad mikkem nazir, sheshshenechem nezirim, shekkullechem nezirim, bet shammay omrim kullam nezirim. uvet hillel omrim, eno nazir ella mi shello nitkayyemu devarav. verabbi tarfon omer, en echad mehem nazir:
5.6: Hirtia laachorav, eno nazir. rabbi shimon omer, yomar, im haya chidvaray, hareni nezir chova. veim lav, hareni nezir nedava:
5.7: Raa et hakkoy veamar, hareni nazir shezze chayya, hareni nazir shezze eno chayya, hareni nazir shezze vehema, hareni nazir sheen ze vehema, hareni nazir shezze chayya uvehema, hareni nazir sheen ze lo chayya velo vehema, hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir, hareni nazir sheen echad mikkem nazir, hareni nazir shekkullechem nezirim, hare chullam nezirim:

6.1: Shelosha minin asurin bannazir, hattuma vehattiglachat vehayyotze min haggafen. vechol hayyotze min haggefen mitztarfin ze im ze. veeno chayyav ad sheyyochal min haanavim kazzayit. mishna rishona, ad sheyyishte reviit yayin. rabbi akiva omer, afillu shara fitto veyayin veyesh bah kede letzaref kazzayit, chayyav:
6.2: Vechayyav al hayyayin bifne atzmo, veal haanavim bifne atzman, veal hachartzannim bifne atzman, veal hazzaggim bifne atzman. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, eno chayyav ad sheyyochal shene chartzannim vezaggan. ellu hen chartzannim veellu hen zaggim, hachartzannim ellu hachitzonim, hazzaggim ellu happenimim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, shello tite, kezog shel behema, hachitzon zog vehappenimi inbal:
6.3: Setam nezirut sheloshim yom. gillach o sheggillechuhu listim, soter sheloshim yom. nazir sheggillach ben bezug ben betaar o shessifsef kol shehu, chayyav. nazir chofef umefaspes, aval lo sorek. rabbi yishmael omer, lo yachof baadama, mippene shemmashsheret et hassear:
6.4: Nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tishte al tishte, vehu shote, chayyav al kol achat veechat. haya megalleach kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tegalleach al tegalleach, vehu megalleach, chayyav al kol achat veechat. haya mittamme lemetim kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tittamma al tittamma, vehu mittamme, chayyav al kol achat veechat:
6.5: Shelosha minin asurin bannazir, hattuma vehattiglachat vehayyotze min haggafen. chomer battuma uvattiglachat mibbayyotze min haggefen, shehattuma vehattiglachat sotrin, vehayyotze min haggefen eno soter. chomer bayyotze min haggefen mibbattuma uvattiglachat, shehayyotze min haggefen lo huttar mikkelalo, vetuma vetiglachat hutteru mikkelalan betiglachat mitzva uvemet mitzva. vechomer battuma mibbattiglachat, shehattuma soteret et hakkol vechayyavin aleha karban, vetiglachat enah soteret ella sheloshim yom veen chayyavin aleha karban:
6.6: Tiglachat hattuma ketzad, haya mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii, umegalleach bashshevii, umevi karbenotav bashshemini. veim gillach bashshemini, mevi karbenotav bo vayyom, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi tarfon, ma ben ze lammetzora. amar lo, ze tohorato teluya veyamav, umetzora tohorato teluya vetiglachto, veeno mevi karban ella im ken haya meorav shamesh:
6.7: Tiglachat hattohora ketzad, haya mevi shalosh behemot, chattat ola ushelamim, veshochet et hashshelamim, umegalleach alehem, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi elazar omer, lo haya megalleach ella al hachattat, shehachattat kodemet bechol makom. veim gillach al achat mishshelashtan, yatza:
6.8: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hevi shalosh behemot velo feresh, haruya lechattat tikrav chattat, leola tikrav ola, lishlamim tikrav shelamim. haya notel sear rosh nizro umeshalleach tachat haddud. veim gillach bammedina haya meshalleach tachat haddud. bamme devarim amurim, betiglachat hattohora. aval betiglachat hattuma, lo haya meshalleach tachat haddud. rabbi meir omer, hakkol meshallechin tachat haddud, chutz min hattame shebbammedina bilvad:
6.9: Haya mevashshel et hashshelamim o sholkan. hakkohen notel et hazzeroa beshela min haayil, vechallat matztza achat min hassal, urekik matztza echad, venoten al kappe hannazir umenifan, veachar kach huttar hannazir lishtot yayin ulehittamme lemetim. rabbi shimon omer, kevan shennizrak alav echad min haddamim, huttar hannazir lishtot beyayin ulehittamme lemetim:
6.10: Gillach al hazzevach venimtza fasul, tiglachto fesula, uzevachav lo alu lo. gillach al hachattat shello lishmah veachar kach hevi karbenotav lishman, tiglachto fesula, uzevachav lo alu lo. gillach al haola o al hashshelamim shello lishman veachar kach hevi karbenotav lishman, tiglachto fesula, uzevachav lo alu lo. rabbi shimon omer, oto hazzevach lo ala lo, aval shear zevachim alu lo. veim gillach al shelashtan venimtza echad mehen kasher, tiglachto cheshera, veyavi shear hazzevachim:
6.11: Mi shennizrak alav echad min haddamim venitma, rabbi eliezer omer, soter et hakkol. vachachamim omrim, yavi shear karbenotav veyithar. amru lo, maase vemiryam hattarmodit shennizrak aleha echad min haddamim, uvau veamru lah al bittah shehayta mesukkenet, vehalcha umetzatah shemmeta, veamru chachamim, tavi shear karbenoteha vetithar:

7.1: Kohen gadol venazir enan mittammein likrovehen, aval mittammein lemet mitzva. hayu mehallechin badderech umatzu met mitzva, rabbi eliezer omer, yittamma chohen gadol veal yittamma nazir. vachachamim omrim, yittamma nazir veal yittamma chohen gadol. amar lahem rabbi eliezer, yittamma chohen sheeno mevi karban al tumato, veal yittamma nazir shehu mevi karban al tumato. amru lo, yittamma nazir sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam, veal yittamma chohen shekkedushshato kedushshat olam:
7.2: Al ellu tumot hannazir megalleach, al hammet, veal kazzayit min hammet, veal kazzayit netzel veal melo tarvad rakav, al hashshidra veal haggulgolet veal ever min hammet veal ever min hachay sheyyesh alav basar karauy, veal chatzi kav atzamot veal chatzi log dam, al maggaan veal massaan veal oholan, veal etzem kasseora, al maggao veal massao. al ellu hannazir megalleach umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii, vesoter et hakkodmin, veeno matchil limnot ella ad sheyyithar umevi et karbenotav:
7.3: Aval hassechachot, vehapperaot, uvet happeras, veeretz haammim, vehaggolel, vehaddofek, ureviit dam, veohel, verova atzamot, vechelim hannogim bemet, vime safro, vime gamro, al ellu en hannazir megalleach, umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii, veeno soter et hakkodmin, umatchil umone miyyad, vekarban en lo. beemet amru, yeme hazzav vehazzava vime hesgero shel metzora, hare ellu olin lo:
7.4: Amar rabbi eliezer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, kol tuma min hammet shehannazir megalleach aleha, chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash. vechol tuma min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach aleha, en chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash. amar rabbi meir, lo tehe zo kalla min hashsheretz. amar rabbi akiva, danti lifne rabbi eliezer, ma im etzem kasseora sheeno metamme adam beohel, hannazir megalleach al maggao veal massao. reviit dam shehu metamme adam beohel, eno din sheyyehe hannazir megalleach al maggaah veal massaah. amar li, ma ze akiva, en danin kan mikkal vachomer. ucheshebbati vehirtzeti et haddevarim lifne rabbi yehoshua, amar li, yafe amarta, ella ken amru halacha:

8.1: Shene nezirim sheamar lahen echad, raiti echad mikkem shennitma veeni yodea eze mikkem, megallechin umeviin karban tuma vekarban tohora, veomer, im ani hu hattame, karban tuma shelli vekarban tohora shellecha. veim ani hu hattahor, karban tohora shelli vekarban tuma shellecha. vesofrin sheloshim yom, umeviin karban tohora, veomer, im ani hu hattame, karban tuma shelli vekarban tohora shellecha veze karban tohorati. veim ani hu hattahor, karban tohora shelli vekarban tuma shellecha veze karban tohoratcha. met echad mehen, amar rabbi yehoshua, yevakkesh echad min hashshuk sheyyiddor kenegdo venazir, veomer, im tame hayiti, hare atta nazir miyyad. veim tahor hayiti, hare atta nazir achar sheloshim yom. vesofrin sheloshim yom, umeviin karban tuma vekarban tohora, veomer, im ani hu hattame, karban tuma shelli vekarban tohora shellech. veim ani hu hattahor, karban tohora shelli vekarban tuma besafek. vesofrin sheloshim yom umeviin karban tohora, veomer, im ani hu hattame, karban tuma shelli vekarban tohora shellecha veze karban tohorati. veim ani hu hattahor, karban tohora shelli vekarban tuma besafek vezehu karban tohoratcha. amar lo ven zoma, umi shomea lo sheyyiddor kenegdo venazir. ella mevi chattat haof veolat behema, veomer, im tame hayiti, hachattat mechovati vehaola nedava. veim tahor hayiti, haola mechovati vehachattat besafek. vesofer sheloshim yom umevi karban tohora, veomer, im tame hayiti, haola harishona nedava vezo chova. veim tahor hayiti, haola harishona chova vezo nedava, veze shear karbani. amar rabbi yehoshua, nimtza ze mevi karbenotav lachatzaim. aval hodu lo chachamim leven zoma:
8.2: Nazir shehaya tame vesafek umuchlat besafek, ochel bakkadashim achar shishshim yom, veshote yayin umittamme lemetim achar mea veesrim yom, shettiglachat hannega docha tiglachat hannazir bizman shehu vadday, aval bizman shehu safek enah docha:

9.1: Haggoyim en lahem nezirut. nashim vaavadim yesh lahem nezirut. chomer bannashim mibbaavadim, shehu chofe et avdo veeno chofe et ishto. chomer baavadim mibbannashim, shehu mefer nidre ishto veeno mefer nidre avdo. hefer leishto, hefer olamit. hefer leavdo, yatza lecherut mashlim neziruto. avar mikkeneged panav, rabbi meir omer, lo yishte, verabbi yose omer, yishte:
9.2: Nazir sheggillach venoda lo shehu tame, im tuma yedua, soter. veim tumat hattehom, eno soter. im ad shello gillach, ben kach uven kach soter. ketzad, yarad litbol bimara venimtza met tzaf al pi hammeara, tame. nimtza meshukka bekarka hammeara, yarad lehaker, tahor. littaher mittumat met, tame, shechezkat tame tame vechezkat tahor tahor, sheraglayim laddavar:
9.3: Hammotze met bitchilla mushkav kedarko, notlo veet tevusato. matza shenayim, notlan veet tevusatan. matza shelosha, im yesh ben ze laze mearba ammot vead shemone, hare zo shechunat kevarot. bodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma. matza echad besof esrim amma, bodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma, sheraglayim laddavar, sheillu mittechilla metzao, notlo veet tevusato:
9.4: Kol sefek negaim battechilla, tahor ad shello nizkak lattuma. mishshennizkak lattuma, sefeko tame. beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav ad shello nizkak lazziva. bemaachol, uvemishte, bemassa, uvikfitza, uvecholi, uvemare, uvehirhur. mishshennizkak lazziva, en bodkin oto. anso usefeko veshichvat zaro, temein, sheraglayim laddavar. hammakke et chavero vaamaduhu lemita, vehekel mimma shehaya, leachar mikkan hichbid umet, chayyav. rabbi nechemya omer, patur, sheraglayim laddavar:
9.5: Nazir haya shemuel, kedivre rabbi nehoray, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 1) umora lo yaale al rosho, neemar beshimshon (Shoftim 13) umora, veneemar bishmuel umora, ma mora haamura veshimshon, nazir, af mora haamura vishmuel, nazir. amar rabbi yose, vahalo en mora ella shel basar vadam. amar lo rabbi nehoray, vahalo chevar neemar (Shmuel 1 16) vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani, shekkevar haya alav mora shel basar vadam:
